Banner.Description: I have 3+ years of experience building scalable backend systems, microservices, and distributed applications in fintech and insurance. I work with Go, Node.js, Java, REST APIs, Kafka, MySQL, and Redis, with a focus on production reliability, latency, and throughput.
AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In my 3+ years of experience as a developer, I seek to train every day. I have worked writing clean and responsive code, performing continuous integration, and covering backend developer roles with Node.js and SQL. I have led teams with empathy, motivating partners, and setting plans and goals together.
I also build microservices, event-driven systems, and production integrations across fintech—with strong focus on reliability, observability, and performance at scale.
Some of the technologies I work with include (but are not limited to):
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Engineer
Description: Owned end-to-end design and development of AU Small Finance Bank (AU SFB) integration, delivering a successful production release; collaborated cross-functionally with BFF, frontend, and operations teams to ensure seamless rollout.
Led solutioning and implementation of RBL Account Aggregator integration, enabling credit card growth with zero downtime and high availability during production launch.
Built and scaled microservices for a credit card platform handling 100,000+ applications/month; developed REST APIs and asynchronous workers using Node.js and Go, reducing processing time by 30%.
Designed and implemented event-driven architecture using Apache Kafka, processing 50,000+ events/day with 99.9% uptime; optimized MySQL and Redis queries, improving system latency by 40%.

Delivered HDFC credit card integration, including application submission, consent management, income verification (Perfios), OTP authentication, and demographic workflows; supported dual-bank journeys (Salesforce + legacy systems).
Engineered Axis Bank background workers for status synchronization, KYC polling, retry mechanisms, and compliance-driven data purging; processed 500+ parallel jobs per batch with high reliability.

Independently migrated 10+ microservices from lending infrastructure to new RU infrastructure with zero downtime, zero production defects, and full service stability, ensuring seamless traffic transition and improved system resilience.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Software Development Engineer I
Description: Integrated ICICI Elevate and Care Ultimate insurance plans, reducing time to market by 35%.
Developed premium calculators with 20+ add-ons and eligibility modules using Node.js and MongoDB.
Improved quote parsing and rendering performance by 20% for 50,000+ daily quotes.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Junior Software Developer
Description: Built payroll and reporting modules used in large-scale government contracts.
Integrated Angular frontend with Node.js backend services, reducing payroll cycle time by 25%.
Implemented Redis caching to reduce API response time by 40%.
